text:
mira: Heads up — nightly perf dash flagged a p95 spike starting ~02:10 UTC, ~30% higher than baseline. looks correlated with last merge (commit abc123). https://dash.redwood.ai/run/61678 :warning:
dev-bot: [alert] p95-latency > SLO (svc=runtime, model=bloomz, window=30m) at 2026-03-18T02:12:00Z :rotating_light:
alex: grabbing logs now. can anyone check kernel selector decisions around that timeframe? suspect kernel-weighting change in abc123
sam: quick profiler dump from one affected pod (02:11):
```
hot func: attention_kernel_v2 (45% CPU)
KV evict loop (18% CPU)
batch_coalesce (12% CPU)
context switch waits ~8ms
```
jen: KV eviction rate jumped 4x at 02:09 on several hosts — eviction counts + re-fetches causing extra latency. trace id: trace/0b9f
kyle: ran a quick bisect in staging. two suspects: commit abc123 (kernel threshold tweak) and commit def456 (batching window tuning). abc123 moved kernel_selector epsilon from 0.02 -> 0.08; def456 shortened batching_max_wait from 6ms -> 2ms.
mira: between the two, which matches the time series?
jen: eviction aligns with abc123 (deploy 02:05). batching change at 01:50 but metrics stayed flat until 02:05.
alex: looking at kernel selection logs: after abc123 we see a new path choosing ungated attention_kernel_v2 for long sequences — that increases KV cache lookups and misses. sample log:
`kernel_selector: chosen attention_kernel_v2 seq=1024 reason=heuristic_epsilon=0.08`
sam: flame snippet shows increased memcpy from KV fetches after selection change. adding raw snippet: ```memcpy_kv: +2.3ms per call (p95)```
ci-bot: CI perf job perf/runtimes-e2e-stable failed on merge abc123 with p95 delta +27% (see https://ci.redwood.ai/build/5421). test suite: nightly-latency-check.
ops: can we hold rollout and pin canary? current canary still running — pausing roll forward now. :hand:
kyle: repro locally by toggling kernel_selector.epsilon to 0.08, see same SSE spike. patch idea: revert epsilon change or make it dynamic by seq-length.
mira: short-term: revert abc123 on prod or patch selector to previous epsilon and restart canary. long-term: add per-sequence length gating and KV-prefetch hints.
alex: I can push a hotfix that pins kernel_selector.epsilon=0.02 via remote config and roll a rolling restart across canaries. will run db-safe restart script.
sam: also recommend increasing KV cache TTL for next hour to reduce thrash: `kv.cache.ttl=60s -> 300s` while we triage.
jen: agreed, will open a quick PR for ttl bump and monitor.
ops: scheduled rolling restart for canary group at 02:40 UTC, will hold wider rollout until green for 30m.
mira: action items:
- alex: push hotfix config and start rolling restart (ETA 15m)
- jen: PR for kv TTL bump and monitor eviction metrics (ETA 10m)
- kyle/sam: prepare revert PR for abc123 if hotfix doesn't restore baseline (ETA 45m)
- ops: keep rollout paused and coordinate rollback if needed
please post status updates in this thread. :eyes:
ci-bot: tagged the failing CI runs and notified authors of abc123.
alex: hotfix deployed to canary at 02:33; canary p95 dropped ~18% within 5m. continuing to watch.
jen: eviction rate falling back to baseline after TTL bump at 02:36.
sam: profiler shows memcpy_kv overhead down ~1.8ms p95.
mira: good progress. leave rollout paused for now — will reconvene at 03:10 to decide revert. thanks all. :thumbsup:
